questions.question: In textile machines, to avoid breaking of threads, soft starters are used. The commonly used method in soft starter is:

explanations.a: Incorrect. DOL gives full voltage starting, causing high torque transients.
explanations.b: Incorrect. Star-delta gives stepped starting, not smooth control.
explanations.c: Correct. Soft starters use thyristor voltage control to gradually increase voltage, providing smooth acceleration.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Current controller is less common; voltage control is standard.

questions.question: Torque of an induction motor can sometimes be given in synchronous-watt. One synchronous-watt is equal to:

explanations.a: Correct. 1 synchronous-watt = 60/(2πNs) N-m, where Ns is synchronous speed in rpm. Since torque (N-m) = (Power in watts × 60)/(2π × Ns).
explanations.b: Incorrect. This gives the inverse relationship.

questions.question: The air gap flux of induction motor does not contain:

explanations.a: Incorrect. Even harmonics are generally absent in balanced systems, but 2nd is absent.
explanations.b: Correct. In a balanced 3-phase system, 3rd harmonics and multiples of 3 are absent in the line quantities and air gap flux due to cancellation.
explanations.c: Incorrect. 5th harmonics are present in the air gap flux.

questions.question: L&T MPR 300 protection relay used for induction motor protection is an:

explanations.a: Incorrect. MPR 300 is not analog electronic.
explanations.b: Correct. MPR 300 is a microprocessor-based digital protection relay.

questions.question: MPR300 protection relay is used for:

explanations.b: Incorrect. Fractional HP motors typically use simpler protection.
explanations.c: Correct. MPR 300 is designed for 3-phase induction motors up to approximately 85 HP (typical rating range).
explanations.d: Incorrect. Larger motors use different protection relays.
